overview: In the first installment of the epic journey, Elias ventures into forgotten realms to uncover the hidden truth behind ancient, mysterious ruins. As he deciphers ancient symbols and navigates dangerous trials, he discovers that these ruins hold the key to unlocking the legendary Last Gate—and awakening forces that have slept for centuries.
tagline: Some gates were never meant to be opened.
title: Elias and the last gate
